fusions.name: Trample Through
fusions.desc: Drives forward in iron-shod strides, dealing 12 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and knocking each 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Shod Kick
fusions.desc: Lashes out with an iron-shod kick, dealing 7 damage and knocking the target 1.5 tiles back. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Outrider's Dash
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

fusions.name: Tireless Companion
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel in iron barding fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds and slowing them by 15% for 2 seconds. You can ride it.
